scope_notes: Mentor.md v3.0.0 owns candidate universes and long-term target roles. V82 and BondV75 do not own the candidate universe.

SGOV has two accounting roles that must remain distinct: SGOV_BOND_BUCKET is formal bond allocation; SGOV_DRY_POWDER_BUCKET is unallocated/stock-waiting liquidity. They may share ticker SGOV but must never be double-counted or freely transferred across roles.
The US bond subbucket target is SGOV 50% / SPSB 35% / BNDW 15%; the Taiwan bond subbucket target is 00859B 80% / 00860B 20%.
00719B, SHY, IEF, SPIB, TLT and SPLB remain valid for research or existing-holding management but are paused as generic new-allocation core candidates.
Client-specific existing/preferred assets remain outside the generic mother-rule lock unless separately version-locked for a client backtest.
This lock records the Mentor snapshot for reproducibility; it does not modify Mentor, V82, BondV75, mother backtest rules, or V70.2.
